llvmss_benchmarkgame_puzzle::static.diagnosis: Control-flow heavy with many loops/blocks and high compute density; O0 leaves unmerged blocks and redundant branches.
llvmss_benchmarkgame_puzzle::static.expected_effect: Fewer retired branches and instructions via CFG merge + peephole.

llvmss_benchmarkgame_puzzle::static_perf.diagnosis: Perf shows extreme branch_misses (10.8x) and conditional_branches (2.4x) plus icache pressure (7.1x); branch structure dominates the slowdown.
llvmss_benchmarkgame_puzzle::static_perf.expected_effect: Reduce conditional branches and branch mispredicts; coalesce-locals trims local traffic.

llvmss_misc_matmul_f64_4x4::static.diagnosis: Dense f64 kernel with very high local_bloat (0.44); O0 emits redundant local.get/set around the inner product.
llvmss_misc_matmul_f64_4x4::static.expected_effect: Eliminate redundant locals and CSE the address arithmetic, cutting retired instructions.

llvmss_misc_matmul_f64_4x4::static_perf.diagnosis: Loads ratio is already <1 and cpu_cycles 0.85; the win is purely instruction-count via local cleanup and constant folding of the 4x4 indices.
llvmss_misc_matmul_f64_4x4::static_perf.expected_effect: Lower instructions_retired through local elimination + precompute of constant strides.

llvmss_misc_richards_benchmark::static.diagnosis: Call-dense scheduler with many small functions; O0 never inlines them so every dispatch is a real call.
llvmss_misc_richards_benchmark::static.expected_effect: Inline small hot callees, then clean locals/dead code to drop call overhead.

llvmss_misc_richards_benchmark::static_p.diagnosis: instructions_retired 1.52x, cpu_cycles 1.85x and loads 1.47x — call overhead and spill traffic dominate.
llvmss_misc_richards_benchmark::static_p.expected_effect: Inlining + coalesce-locals reduce loads and retired instructions from O0 spills.

llvmss_misc_salsa20::static.diagnosis: Stream cipher with the highest local_bloat (0.45); rounds reuse many temporaries that O0 spills.
llvmss_misc_salsa20::static.expected_effect: Collapse redundant locals and CSE the rotate/xor expressions.

llvmss_misc_salsa20::static_perf.diagnosis: Most perf ratios are <1 (wasm already faster); only modest local-level cleanup is warranted to avoid regressions.
llvmss_misc_salsa20::static_perf.expected_effect: Small instruction-count reduction without disturbing the already-good codegen.

llvmss_misc_evalloop::static.diagnosis: Expression interpreter: high branch_density, call_density and block_density; O0 leaves a large dispatch with unmerged blocks.
llvmss_misc_evalloop::static.expected_effect: Simplify the dispatch CFG and trim locals.

llvmss_misc_evalloop::static_perf.diagnosis: conditional_branches blow up 13.4x and icache 9.5x — the interpreter dispatch is the bottleneck; inlining handlers plus CFG merge should help most.
llvmss_misc_evalloop::static_perf.expected_effect: Inline small op handlers and merge branch chains to cut conditional branches.

llvmss_misc_flops::static.diagnosis: FP mix with extreme local_bloat (0.51) and large average function size; O0 spills heavily.
llvmss_misc_flops::static.expected_effect: Major local elimination + CSE on the arithmetic-heavy body.

llvmss_misc_flops::static_perf.diagnosis: cpu_cycles already 0.63x; branches 1.46x and stores 1.49x suggest local/store traffic from O0 — coalescing and precompute target it.
llvmss_misc_flops::static_perf.expected_effect: Reduce stores and retired instructions from redundant locals.

llvmss_misc_flops-1::static.diagnosis: FP kernel variant with high branch_density and compute_density but low local_bloat; peephole + branch cleanup matter most.
llvmss_misc_flops-1::static.expected_effect: Fold constants and simplify branch structure.

llvmss_misc_flops-1::static_perf.diagnosis: conditional_branches 5.8x and branch_misses 10x with icache 4.9x — branch structure clearly dominates.
llvmss_misc_flops-1::static_perf.expected_effect: Cut conditional branches and mispredicts via CFG simplification.

llvmss_stanford_floatmm::static.diagnosis: FP matmul with high call_density and compute_density; small helpers plus index arithmetic to fold.
llvmss_stanford_floatmm::static.expected_effect: Inline helpers and precompute constant matrix strides.

llvmss_stanford_floatmm::static_perf.diagnosis: icache 7.7x is the main anomaly; other ratios near 1, so favor inlining + branch cleanup to compact the hot loop.
llvmss_stanford_floatmm::static_perf.expected_effect: Tighter hot loop reduces icache misses and instructions.

llvmss_stanford_puzzle::static.diagnosis: Recursive solver: high loops/blocks, high local_bloat (0.47) and large functions; both local cleanup and inlining apply.
llvmss_stanford_puzzle::static.expected_effect: Inline + collapse locals to shrink the recursive body.

llvmss_stanford_puzzle::static_perf.diagnosis: icache misses 20.9x dominate; reduce code footprint with DCE after inlining rather than aggressive local expansion.
llvmss_stanford_puzzle::static_perf.expected_effect: Smaller hot working set lowers icache misses.

llvmss_stanford_perm::static.diagnosis: Recursive permutation generator, call-dense with high compute; O0 leaves all calls out-of-line.
llvmss_stanford_perm::static.expected_effect: Inline recursion helpers and clean dead/local code.

llvmss_stanford_perm::static_perf.diagnosis: cpu_cycles 2.84x, instructions 1.72x, loads 1.82x and icache 24.9x — heavy call+spill overhead from O0 recursion.
llvmss_stanford_perm::static_perf.expected_effect: Inlining + local coalescing cut loads, instructions and call overhead.

llvmss_stanford_towers::static.diagnosis: Towers of Hanoi recursion, call-dense; inline the move helper and clean up.
llvmss_stanford_towers::static.expected_effect: Reduce call overhead and dead code.

llvmss_stanford_towers::static_perf.diagnosis: instructions 1.96x, cpu 2.46x, stores 1.86x and branch_misses 8.75x; recursion spill + call overhead dominate.
llvmss_stanford_towers::static_perf.expected_effect: Inline + coalesce reduce stores/instructions from O0 recursion frames.

llvmss_stanford_queens::static.diagnosis: N-queens backtracking: medium branch density, high block density; CFG cleanup plus peephole.
llvmss_stanford_queens::static.expected_effect: Simplify backtracking branches and trim locals.

llvmss_stanford_queens::static_perf.diagnosis: branch_misses 13.2x, icache 26.4x and instructions 1.57x; inline the placement check and simplify branches.
llvmss_stanford_queens::static_perf.expected_effect: Fewer mispredicted branches and a more compact hot path.
